facts.text: Jon expresses that dance is a way to express himself and find happiness, and he is grateful for Gina's support.

evidence.quote: I'm happy that dance has such a special meaning to both of us. It's a really cool way to express ourselves. I loved taking lessons with my friends when I was younger. Those memories are so precious. So glad I can still enjoy it with my own studio. Thanks for always being there for me.
Dancing for me is like a way to express myself and find my happy place. I used to be scared to death of what people would think, but I learnt that my own happiness is the most important thing.

facts.text: Gina acknowledges Jon's dedication and hard work, and encourages him to continue with his dance journey.

evidence.quote: No prob, Jon! You earned all the kudos for your hard work. Keep it up!
Way to go, Jon! Keep it up, you're almost there!

facts.text: Gina shares a photo of a trophy from a dance contest, which serves as a reminder of the hard work, dedication, and joy associated with dance.

evidence.quote: Here's one of my trophies from a dance contest, nice reminder of the hard work, dedication and joy it brings.

facts.text: Jon appreciates Gina's support and expresses his intention to continue working hard in his dance journey.

evidence.quote: Wow! It looks awesome! Thanks for the support, it really means a lot.
Thanks! Gonna keep pushing and working hard. Won't let anything hold me back!
